description: A perpetual-futures research repo carrying at least one defect from every category in the taxonomy.

expected.note: PnL never subtracts the fee that config.py defines but nothing imports.
The universe is the venue's current listings, applied across the whole history.
funding_next attaches the next hour's funding rate to this hour's bar.
The FEATURES list contains the target column itself.
The scaler is fitted before the split, so it has seen the test period.
train_test_split shuffles hourly bars with a four-hour forward label.
Thirty threshold/holding-period combinations, scored on `test`, maximum returned.
Thirty trials with no correction for the number of them.
